title: Crash with KeyError: 'llm' when config.toml is empty
body: I created an empty config.toml and ran repobrief run. It crashed with KeyError: 'llm'.

title: HTTP 403 rate limit exceeded on large repositories
body: Summarizing big repositories fails halfway with HTTP 403 rate limit exceeded.

title: Add dark mode to the web viewer
body: The report page is very bright. A dark theme would be easier on the eyes at night.

title: UnicodeEncodeError when printing a summary on Windows
body: On Windows the summary crashes with UnicodeEncodeError: 'charmap' codec can't encode character.

title: Support Python 3.13
body: Installation fails on Python 3.13 because a dependency has no wheel yet.

title: Export reports as PDF
body: I need to attach summaries to emails. A --format pdf option would help.

title: Typo in installation guide
body: The Windows section says pip instal instead of pip install.

title: Port 8000 already in use
body: repobrief serve fails with OSError: address already in use. How do I pick another port?

title: Model request times out on long READMEs
body: Repositories with a very long README fail with ReadTimeout while waiting for the model.

title: Summaries ignore files in subfolders
body: The file tree section only lists files in the top folder of the repository.

title: Allow choosing the summary language
body: I would like summaries in Spanish. Maybe a --language option?

title: CSV export puts everything in one column in Excel
body: When I open the csv export in Excel all text is in column A.

title: SSL CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED behind company proxy
body: At work every run fails with ssl.SSLCertVerificationError CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED.

title: Document the [web] section of config.toml
body: The configuration guide does not explain the [web] settings.

title: Private repositories return 404
body: repobrief run on my private repository says 404 Not Found, public ones work.

title: Add a --quiet flag
body: I run repobrief from scripts and would like to turn off the progress output.

title: Web viewer shows a blank page in Safari
body: repobrief serve works in Chrome and Firefox, but Safari only shows a white page.

title: JSON export escapes non-ASCII characters
body: Names like Müller become M\u00fcller in the json export.

title: Support GitLab repositories
body: Our code is on GitLab. It would be great if repobrief could summarize GitLab projects.

title: Progress bar freezes at 99%
body: The progress bar stops at 99% for several minutes before the summary appears.

title: Crash when the repository has no README
body: repobrief run crashes with FileNotFoundError when the repository has no README file.

title: Explain how to use a local model
body: The installation guide should explain how to use Ollama.

title: Cache GitHub responses between runs
body: Running twice on the same repository downloads everything again.

title: repobrief is not recognized as a command
body: After pip install, PowerShell says repobrief is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet.

title: Summary cuts off mid-sentence
body: The last paragraph of the summary often stops in the middle of a sentence.
